reviews.x: My almost 8 year old who is petite loves this headband. Told her she can't wear it before her party, but she keeps putting it on.  ETA: worked perfect for her party. See picture. She continues to wear the headband and it's held up well.

reviews.t: This is SUPER cute & my daughter loves it!
reviews.x: Update: This is super cute & my daughter loves it. Customer service is excellent! They reached out & I told them the cord had come loose and they sent a new one with bonus unicorn balloons. Very impressed with them!  She got lots of headbands for her birthday and this is hands down the fave.

Perfect quality , made of sturdy fabric and beautiful flowers , perfect fitting for any little girl,  speed of lighting shipping , everyone loved the whole unicorn theme , and took down the info where I got it from to order for their baby shower and daughter birthday ... she wore it on 3/24/18 for her bd celebration , than all day on 3/25/18 and 3/26/18 on her actual bd , she wore it out to go shopping and she got so many compliments :) Thank you for providing such a well made product  The unico

reviews.t: Cute unicorn headband that fits an adult
reviews.x: My (adult) friend looked so cute in this crown on her birthday! The headband is sturdy but not too hard so it won't hurt your head. One weird thing is that the pink spots (showing what side is the "inner ear") were on both sides of the gold glitter ears. I noticed this immediately, but no one else seemed to notice at all so keep that in mind if you are picky like me. Overall, this was a seriously adorable item that brought smiles to a birthday girl and is sturdy enough to be used again a

reviews.t: Balloons busted, but headband was great
reviews.x: The only reason I give this a 3 is because I bought this just as much for the mylar balloons as I did the headband.  The headband was great, but the balloons were terrible.  They were so tiny they would've looked kind of ridiculous even if they would've blown up, but instead when we attempted to blow them up they both busted open and ripped.  Thankfully, we had seen some just like them at Publix that were huge and awesome that we got instead after these busted.

The headband was cute, but the balloons were not inflatable. I took them to get helium put in them and they told me they weren't meant for helium. They are supposed to be blown up with a "straw" and they just sit on the end of the straw. However they did not come with this straw so I could not blow them up and we didn't get to use them for my daughters party. I was disappointed.

reviews.t: The balloons that came with mine were minuscule and a waist
reviews.x: The horn and ears were flimsy but got the job done but I based my entire purchase on the Ballons.  The balloons that came with mine were minuscule and a waste.  They were super small and so heavy they need and stick and assembly to hold them upright.
The crown was very cute and seems well made. Although, the balloons were very disappointing!! They are really small not much bigger than the headband. And they do not float when filled with helium.
Perfect for my best friends 35th bday smash cake photo shoot. Lol Also good for little kids, I suppose.

reviews.t: The headband is great! The balloons... don't expect much.
reviews.x: Bought this for my daughter to wear on her birthday and she loved it. The headband fit well without digging in to her head. The balloons were ok and can not be filled with helium... they pop. I used a straw (not included) to blow up the second one and attached it to the birthday banner. It worked well- just not the way I planned.

reviews.t: Great headband, not so great balloons
reviews.x: The headband was great! I liked the unicorn balloons, but I did not realize that the could not be inflated with helium.  They are the kind of small balloons that go on a stick, and the stick was not included. I was expected the balloons to be large enough to fill with helium, and that was not clear in the description

It would’ve been nice if I could’ve received what I ordered. However, I received a cake topper in place of the headband. Unicorn balloons are extremely too small as well. Luckily, I’m crafty and will just take the stem off the cake topper and attach it to a headband that I’ll have to go buy. ....Thanks.

The girls loved these headbands. Ordered 5 and they were all flawless. So perfectly put together....pretty much made with love. The unicorn balloons that came with every headband are definitely a bonus. Such a bargain.

reviews.x: The head band was good but the balloons had holes in them and deinflated when we blow them so I was not happy with the quality of the balloons at a I bnb had to buy more from another store
Super fast shipping ~ great communication! Unicorn headband and balloons described perfectly. Granddaughter loved them. Would buy from Seller again!
Cute headband. My daughter loved it. Didn’t use the foil balloons. They were mini. But overall I really purchased for the headband.

reviews.t: Headpiece is cool but balloons don’t work
reviews.x: I love the headpiece but I couldn’t get the stick balloons filled. A party store couldn’t even blow them up. Ended up in the trash.

My daughter loved these for her Unicorn birthday party :-) we used the headbands again on Halloween!

claims.text: The headband itself is widely praised as cute, well made, and comfortable to wear, fitting both children and adults.
The included balloons are a common disappointment, frequently described as very small and not suitable for helium.
Some reviewers report balloon quality problems such as holes, deflation, or missing straws/sticks needed to inflate them.
Customer service is praised, with one reviewer noting a replacement sent after a loose cord.
Shipping is described as fast, and the product is considered a good value.
